source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 30 — WATERS OF DELIGHT AND MORE AROMATIC TREES — Aramaic 4Q206 1 xxi partial; Greek Akhmim 30:1-3 complete; Ge'ez full.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐπάνω αὐτῶν ὑπεράνω, ἀπὸ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς αὐτῶν οὐ μακράν, εἶδον ἄλλον τόπον, φάραγγας ὕδατος ὥσπερ ἐκλείπον.
verses.translit: Kai epanō autōn hyperanō, apo pros anatolas autōn ou makran, eidon allon topon, pharangas hydatos hōsper ekleipon.
verses.text_geez: ወመልዕልቶሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽባሕተ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ኢርሑቅ፡ ርእኩ፡ ካልአ፡ መካነ፡ ቈላተ፡ ማይ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኢየሐልቅ፡
verses.notes: Eastward valleys of water ever-flowing — paradisal terrain.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ εἶδον δένδρον καλόν, καὶ τὴν ὀσμὴν τοῦ μαστιχοδαφνου ὁμοίαν.
verses.translit: Kai eidon dendron kalon, kai tēn osmēn tou mastichodaphnou homoian.
verses.text_geez: ወርእኩ፡ ዕፀ፡ ሥቡሐ፡ ወሕብሉ፡ ይመስል፡ ናርዶስ፡
verses.notes: A beautiful tree smelling like mastic/nard. Aromatic-paradise inventory.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν χειλέων τῶν φαραγγῶν τούτων εἶδον τὴν κιννάμωμον εὐώδη· καὶ ἐπέκεινα τῶν φαραγγῶν τούτων ἐπορεύθην πρὸς ἀνατολάς.
verses.translit: Kai epi tōn cheileōn tōn pharangōn toutōn eidon tēn kinnamōmon euōdē; kai epekeina tōn pharangōn toutōn eporeuthēn pros anatolas.
verses.text_geez: ወውስተ፡ ከናፍረ፡ እማንቱ፡ ቈላት፡ ርእኩ፡ ቀርፋ፡ ምዑዘ፡ ወማዕዶተ፡ እማንቱ፡ ቈላት፡ ሖርኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡
verses.notes: Fragrant cinnamon on the valley edges. Cf. Exod 30:23 (cinnamon as ingredient of the holy anointing oil); Song 4:14. The geographical-pilgrimage now moves further east.
